tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Embedded submanifold cannot be nonpositively curved] 1. ch9:9-6Let $M \subseteq \mathbb {R}^3$ be a compact, embedded, 2-dimensional Riemannian submanifold. Show that $M$ cannot have $K \leq 0$ everywhere. [Hint: Look at a point where the distance from the origin takes a maximum.] \end{exercise}
